methods.description: Calculates package pricing and initializes the selected payment provider when required. The status defaults to `pending`. Creating an already-paid invoice by setting `status` to `paid` requires a superuser or an active superuser's API key (Static or Bearer), including requests using `X-Impersonate-User`. For wallet payments, omit `status`: the invoice is created as pending and becomes paid after the balance is debited successfully. For your own billing system, confirm payment on your backend before sending gateway=manual and status=paid with a superuser credential. Sending user_id also requires is_reseller; omit user_id for a purchase by the caller. Sub-users cannot create invoices themselves. A paid package purchase creates or tops up the recipient's order for that package. Repeated purchases reuse the order. Finite expiring purchases have separate data ledgers; compatible non-expiring purchases and unlimited packages may reuse a ledger. This is different from assigning a child quota with /users/{id}/data/add. An amount-only invoice tops up money, not data. Persist the invoice ID and use Idempotency-Key for retries. Before delivering access, read the paid invoice and the resulting order: fulfillment can be recovered asynchronously. Accounting webhooks do not include invoice.paid.

fields.name: email
fields.description: Valid email address for account creation

fields.name: password
fields.description: Strong password meeting security requirements

fields.name: token
fields.description: Cloudflare Turnstile security token

fields.name: affiliate_code
fields.description: Optional affiliate referral code

fields.name: referral_code
fields.description: Optional user referral code

fields.name: package_id
fields.description: Package of the managed virtual child order.

fields.name: data
fields.description: Positive integer bytes to remove from assigned quota, not from usage. Cannot exceed total assigned data. Does not credit the parent's pool.

fields.name: token
fields.description: Short-lived access token used in the Authorization header.

fields.name: refresh
fields.description: Long-lived token used to request a new access token.

fields.name: refresh
fields.description: A valid refresh token.

fields.name: access
fields.description: New access token for the same account session.

models.name: User
models.description: Customer account with contact details, security settings, package data, referral information, and managed sub-users visible to the caller.

fields.name: username
fields.description: Value must contain only letters, numbers, and underscores. It must not start or end with an underscore.

fields.name: is_reseller
fields.description: Reseller can create sub-users and manage their data.

fields.name: is_marketer
fields.description: Marketer can manage marketing campaigns and view analytics.

fields.name: is_superuser
fields.description: Designates that this user has all permissions without explicitly assigning them.

fields.name: date_joined_ts
fields.description: Timestamp of when the user joined

fields.name: allowed_ips
fields.description: List of IP addresses allowed for this user

fields.name: blocked_domains
fields.description: List of domains blocked for this user

fields.name: connection_limit
fields.description: The maximum number of concurrent connections allowed for this package.

fields.name: parent_id
fields.description: ID of the parent user (for sub-accounts)

fields.name: sub_users
fields.description: Number of sub-users managed by this reseller

fields.name: referrals
fields.description: Number of users referred by this user

fields.name: currency
fields.description: Currency information for the user's transactions

fields.name: coupons
fields.description: Available coupons for this user

fields.name: data
fields.description: Present only when SITE_PACKAGE_BASED_AUTH is disabled.

fields.name: data_spent
fields.description: Present only when SITE_PACKAGE_BASED_AUTH is disabled.

fields.name: data_updated
fields.description: Present only when SITE_PACKAGE_BASED_AUTH is disabled.

fields.name: proxy_password
fields.description: Present only when SITE_PACKAGE_BASED_AUTH is disabled.

fields.name: proxy_password_reset
fields.description: Present only when SITE_PACKAGE_BASED_AUTH is disabled.

fields.name: orders
fields.description: The user's package orders, including inactive orders. Each order contains its own data allowance, usage, ledgers, and proxy credentials. An empty list means the user has no orders.

models.name: UserCreateRequest
models.description: Fields accepted when a reseller or administrator creates a customer account.

fields.name: email
fields.description: User's email address. Must be unique if provided.

fields.name: username
fields.description: Unique username for the account. Must be 4-128 characters.

fields.name: password
fields.description: Account password. Must be 8-128 characters long.

fields.name: first_name
fields.description: User's first name.

fields.name: last_name
fields.description: User's last name.

fields.name: country
fields.description: User's country of residence.

fields.name: state
fields.description: User's state or province.

fields.name: city
fields.description: User's city.

fields.name: address
fields.description: User's street address.

fields.name: zip
fields.description: User's postal/ZIP code.

fields.name: blocked_domains
fields.description: List of domains to block for this user.

fields.name: allowed_ips
fields.description: List of source IP addresses allowed for this user. The maximum list size is configured per deployment.

fields.name: connection_limit
fields.description: Maximum number of concurrent connections allowed for the user.

fields.name: is_reseller
fields.description: Whether the user should have reseller privileges. Only superusers can create resellers.

fields.name: is_top_level
fields.description: Superuser only: true creates an independent account with no parent. False (default) creates a sub-user under the caller.

fields.name: data
fields.description: Initial integer-byte data amount. With package_id, a normal sub-user receives a virtual quota from the caller's existing root order; is_top_level=true provisions a separate paid purchase. Omit both data and package_id to create identity without package access.

fields.name: package_id
fields.description: ProxyRequest package UUID to assign to the user. Headless integrations resolve it from their local product mapping.

fields.name: meta
fields.description: Additional metadata for the user. Maximum 50 fields.

fields.name: package_id
fields.description: Package whose order's proxy password should be rotated.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Context in which this webhook operates. Determines which events are delivered. User events scoped to the associated user account Reseller events scoped to the reseller and their sub-accounts System platform-wide system events * `user` - User * `reseller` - Reseller * `system` - System

fields.name: endpoint
fields.description: HTTPS URL that receives webhook POST requests when events are triggered. https://example.com/webhooks/proxy The endpoint must be publicly accessible and respond within the configured read timeout.

fields.name: secret
fields.description: Secret used to sign each webhook payload. The receiving endpoint should verify the signature to confirm the request originated from this platform. Auto-generated if left blank. Store this value securely on the receiving end.

fields.name: read_timeout
fields.description: Maximum time to wait for the endpoint to return a response. Requests that exceed this limit are treated as failed and may be retried.

fields.name: write_timeout
fields.description: Maximum time to wait while sending the payload to the endpoint. Requests that exceed this limit are treated as failed and may be retried.

fields.name: retries
fields.description: Number of additional delivery attempts after an initial failure. Set to 0 to disable retries. 3 → up to 4 total delivery attempts

fields.name: retry_timeout
fields.description: How long to wait before each retry attempt after a failed delivery. 10 → retry after 10 seconds
